description: This file implements the SessionServerManager class, which manages the lifecycle and state transitions of a session server in the Rialto media server. It handles initialization, configuration, state changes (active, inactive, not running), logging levels, and communication with other components such as application management, session management, playback, and control services.

classes.name: SessionServerManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle, configuration, and state transitions of a session server, coordinating between playback, cdm, control services, and application/session management servers.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session server manager with command-line arguments, setting up the application management server.

methods.name: startService
methods.description: Blocks until the service is stopped.

methods.name: stopService
methods.description: Stops the service and notifies waiting threads.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Configures the session server with socket name, state, resource limits, display name, and permissions, then starts the session management server.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the session server's state to active, inactive, or not running, handling necessary transitions.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Configures logging levels for various components.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings the control service with a given ID and acknowledgment sender.

methods.name: switchToActive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the active state, starting playback and cdm services, and notifying the application management server.

methods.name: switchToInactive
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the inactive state, stopping playback and cdm services, and notifying the application management server.

methods.name: switchToNotRunning
methods.description: Transitions the session server to the not running state, stopping services and freeing resources.
